verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a public exceptions API: clients POST a JSON payload to https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices. Its docs point users of unsupported languages to that API, so a custom client can report errors without an official SDK. missing for 10: the full payload schema and auth details are not shown in the evidence, there is no machine-readable spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), there is no evidence of third-party compatible SDKs or independent hands-on use, and the evidence covers only error notices, not other event types such as Insights events.

support.subject: As a developer, the event-ingestion protocol is documented and open enough that custom clients and compatible SDKs can send events without an official SDK

citations.quote: Your JSON payload should be submitted as the body of a POST request to https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices
Are you using a language or framework that we don’t officially support yet? You still have a few options
